---
title: "Call for Papers"
---
___
We invite submissions for **TU+12**, which will be held in-person at Rutgers University, on April 17–18, 2027.

- Abstracts can be submitted for 30-minute talks (20-min. talk + 10-min. Q&A), poster presentations, or both.

- All abstracts will be anonymously peer-reviewed.<br><br>

### Important Information
___
- <b>Submission Deadline</b>: December 22, 2026<br>
- <b>Notification of Acceptance</b>: January 31, 2027<br>
- <b>Workshop Dates</b>: April 17-18, 2027<br>
- <b>Location</b>: New Brunswick, NJ<br><br>


### Submission Guidelines
___
- Abstracts must be anonymous and not contain excessive references to the publications of the author(s) or acknowledgments to granting agencies or academic bodies.
- Abstracts should contain original research that, at the time of submission, has neither been published nor accepted for publication.
- Authors may be involved in at most **two submissions**: i) one individual abstract and one joint abstract, or ii) two joint works.
- Abstracts should not exceed **2 pages** in letter or A4 format with 1 inch margin on all sides, including examples, figures, and references.
- The font should not be smaller than 11pt.
- Submissions should be in **PDF format**.<br><br>

### Topics
___
We welcome contributions on all aspects of linguistic research on Turkic languages, as well as on:<br>
- Languages in contact with Turkic<br>
- Languages spoken in regions where Turkic languages are spoken<br>
- Theoretical, experimental, and computational approaches<br><br>

### How to Submit
___
Submissions should be made through the [OpenReview platform](https://openreview.net/challenge?redirect=%2Fgroup%3Fid%3DTUplus%2F2027%2FWorkshop) by Sunday, December 22, 2026, 11:59 pm EST. <br>
- Please reach out to us at [turkicworkshop12@gmail.com](mailto:turkicworkshop12@gmail.com) if you have any questions.<br>
- <i>Make sure to create an OpenReview account at least two weeks prior to the submission deadline since it may take up to two weeks for your accounts to be verified.</i><br><br>
